run_blendedmvs_dataset: run the BlendedMVS WAI dataset loader with argparse to sample and visualize scenes using rerun
create_blendedmvs_dataset: create a BlendedMVSWAI dataset instance with a specific split, resolution, and number of views
review_blendedmvs_get_views: review the BlendedMVSWAI class _get_views method that loads images, depthmaps, and camera poses from WAI format scenes
refactor_blendedmvs_load_data: refactor the BlendedMVSWAI class _load_data method to load scene lists from numpy metadata files
